name: Wood ticker 3-against-4
desc: Wooden sibling of the shaker weave: vcsl claves in {3}%4 with subtle per-cycle detune, woodblocks stuttering 5-against-8 underneath, cabasa in 3-over-2 breathing in and out via mask at peak. Dry, clicky, ritualistic — the acoustic answer to the 808 tins.

code.full: stack(s("{clave clave clave}%4").speed("<1 1.06 .94 1>").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("{woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~}%8").n("<0 1>").gain(${gain}*.7).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).shape(.2).lpf(${cut}).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("{clave clave clave}%4").speed("<1 1.06 .94 1>").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("{woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock}%8").n("<0 1>").gain(${gain}*.7).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("{cabasa cabasa cabasa}%2").gain(${gain}*.5).mask("<1 1 0 1>").every(4, x=>x.ply(2))).shape(.2).lpf(${cut}).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
